_meta.what: 3D models of real buildings, written from the owner's photos. The game builds each one: walls up to eave_m, a roof, and the windows, doors, signs and awnings on each wall.
_meta.units: metres. facades are keyed by wall number (shown in the game's building card); x runs along the wall from its left end as seen from outside, y up from the ground.
_meta.roof_types: flat, hip, gable, mansard (a sloped band of band_m around a flat top)
_meta.status: draft = estimated from one photo, to check against the owner's own photos; checked = matched to the owner's photos
